title: TrueView
summary: Real-time condition monitoring for conveyors and fixed plant, streaming sensor data into a single health view for reliability crews.
outcomeStatement: Reduce unplanned fixed-plant downtime by detecting degradation before failure.
businessValue: Less unplanned downtime and longer asset life through earlier intervention.
lastUpdate: Scaled to three processing hubs; sensor coverage now at 78%.

title: HydroHaul
summary: Optimises mine dewatering and water-cart haulage scheduling using live pit and weather signals.
outcomeStatement: Cut water-cart fuel burn and dust exceedances across active pits.
businessValue: Lower water-cart fuel and dust exceedances, with better water reuse.
lastUpdate: Fleet telemetry integration behind schedule; vendor API delayed to July.

title: Integrated Cadence Tool
summary: Aligns short-interval-control cadence across mining and processing so crews plan to a common rhythm.
outcomeStatement: Standardise SIC cadence and lift plan adherence across operations.
businessValue: Higher plan adherence and a common operating rhythm across mining and processing.
lastUpdate: Prototyping with OE/BI at Greater Tom Price and Hope Downs 1; engaged at West Angelas.

title: Frontline AI Insights
summary: Surfaces operational insights to frontline supervisors through natural-language questions over operational data.
outcomeStatement: Help supervisors make faster, better-informed shift decisions.
businessValue: Faster supervisor decisions from natural-language access to operational data.
lastUpdate: Discovery interviews complete; four candidate use cases prioritised.

title: DIGBY
summary: Digital control-room assistant for load-out and train scheduling, guiding operators through standard responses.
outcomeStatement: Reduce manual control-room interventions during load-out.
businessValue: Fewer manual control-room interventions and more consistent load-out.
lastUpdate: Design review flagged scope risk on the train-ordering integration.

title: RSM Work Management
summary: Rolls out the reliability and shutdown maintenance work-management standard with supporting tooling.
outcomeStatement: Improve maintenance schedule compliance across sites.
businessValue: Better maintenance schedule compliance and reliability outcomes.
lastUpdate: Two key vendor resources rolled off; build milestone slipped six weeks.

title: Paperless Maintainer
summary: Replaces paper maintenance checksheets with mobile forms used at the workface.
outcomeStatement: Eliminate paper checksheets and capture maintenance data at source.
businessValue: No paper at the workface and maintenance data captured at source.
lastUpdate: Pilot running at West Angelas; 1,283 paper forms retired so far.

title: Digital Shift Handover
summary: Structured digital shift handover that carries open actions and risks across crews.
outcomeStatement: Reduce information loss between shifts and crews.
businessValue: Less information lost between shifts and safer, smoother crew transitions.
lastUpdate: Engaged and piloting across seven sites; OE/BI, Production and Development progressing.

title: Integrated Safety Intelligence
summary: Consolidates safety signals from multiple systems into a single, ranked risk view.
outcomeStatement: Detect high-potential risk earlier across the operation.
businessValue: Earlier detection of high-potential risk from consolidated safety signals.
lastUpdate: Core data model built; two of five source systems integrated.

title: Control Room Digital
summary: Ongoing modernisation and support of the control-room digital platform underpinning other initiatives.
outcomeStatement: Maintain a stable, supported control-room toolset for operations.
businessValue: A stable, supported control-room platform underpinning other initiatives.
lastUpdate: Quarterly platform patching complete; platform uptime 99.4%.

title: Daily Performance Insights
summary: Surfaces daily production and performance insights to frontline crews and supervisors across mining work areas.
outcomeStatement: Lift daily performance conversations with shared, trusted numbers.
businessValue: Faster, data-led shift reviews and earlier correction of performance gaps across multiple sites.
lastUpdate: Piloting across Production, Drill & Blast and Development at five sites; engaged at Gudai-Darri.

title: Digital Work Management
summary: Digitises maintenance and operational work management, replacing spreadsheets and paper routines.
outcomeStatement: A single digital flow for planning, scheduling and closing out work.
businessValue: Improved schedule compliance and visibility of work status across sites.
lastUpdate: Design under way with OE/BI and Production at Hope Downs 1.

title: E-Permitting
summary: Replaces paper permits to work with a digital permitting workflow for high-risk work.
outcomeStatement: Safer, faster, auditable permit-to-work across the operation.
businessValue: Reduced permit errors and a clear audit trail for high-risk work.
lastUpdate: Discovery started with HSEC and OE/BI; scoping first sites.
